title: 9、梦魇（修）
content_zh:
“划水的鱼我认了，但搅棍的屎像话吗？”林小笑瞪着眼睛看向叶晚：“老板埋汰我就算了，你瞎闹什么？”
“实话实说而已，”叶晚平静回答：“说正事，你打算怎么试探那小子？”
林小笑想了想，然后意味深长的笑道：“先让他做个噩梦。”
叶晚皱眉：“适可而止。”
“放心。”
这时，囚犯们打饭的队伍后面出现了骚乱，林小笑看了过去。
18号监狱就像是一个巨大且空旷的铁盒子，开饭时21名机器警卫分布在四周，每一位都荷枪实弹。
它们没有人类的情感，并处理这监狱中的一切突发状况。
21名机器警卫相比三千多名犯人有点少了，但这里的每一个犯人都知道，头顶镶嵌在高高穹顶的无人机与六枪管金属风暴才是真正的威胁。
冰冷，且强大。
中午开饭时，所有犯人都准时来到餐厅外排列成纵队，然后按楼层顺序打饭。
不仅如此，每个犯人还都必须站在属于自己的位置上。
有新人记不住自己的队列位置，便会立刻被机器警卫围上来进行警告，如果警告后还无法归位，便会被机器警卫们进行电击惩罚，然后押解到属于他们的位置上。
新囚犯们上午先是挨了一顿欢迎仪式，这时候头昏脑涨的哪能
而老囚犯呢，则一个个像看笑话似的等待着他们出丑，这似乎就是每次新囚犯被押解进来后的固定娱乐项目。
此时老囚犯们忽然觉得有点不对劲，早上那位跟李叔同下棋的少年怎么没被处罚？
众人目光在人群里找去，赫然发现庆尘正站在属于他自己的位置上，神色平静的注视着一切。
奇了怪了，每个纵队少说都有五百人，这么多陌生的面孔站在一起，这少年凭什么能找到自己的位置？
而庆尘，正打量着那些与自己一起关押进来的“新人们”。
只见那些新人一个个脸上什么伤痕都没有，可是走路姿态却非常古怪，像是在忍受着疼痛。

看样子囚犯们下手也是有分寸的，不打脸，下手也不会致命。
他端着盘子往前走去，却有一只手突然把他拉出打饭的队伍。
庆尘愣住了，他转头看着林小笑拉扯着他边走边说：“以后你就不用跟着他们排队了，能跟老板下棋的人，排什么队啊。”
庆尘下意识便看向那些机器警卫，生怕自己走出队形会被电击处罚。
结果，他却发现机器警卫竟完全无视了自己，并催促其他囚犯填补上了他的位置！
庆尘想不明白，就算李叔同等人身份特殊，也不至于特殊到如此地步吧？！
林小笑拉着他从长长的几排队列中穿过，打饭、坐在李叔同对面吃饭，种种举动一气呵成。
两边的囚犯们默默看着这一幕，所有人的目光都紧紧沾在庆尘的身上。
原本嘈杂的环境一瞬间安静下来，仿佛大家连呼吸都屏住了。
这一刻他们意识到，庆尘和他们不再一样了。
林小笑蹲在庆尘一旁的椅子上笑眯眯说道：“不用惊奇，能跟老板下棋的人，自然要有一些特殊待遇，赶紧吃吧，虽然这18号监狱里的饭菜一点都不好吃。”
庆尘抬头看向对面的李叔同，对方慢吞吞的吃着饭，没有要跟他交谈的意思。
他再看向人群里，队列里面的路广义正悄悄的对他竖起大拇指……
庆尘不明白，早上的时候李叔同还只是愿意与自己下棋，怎么过了一个上午，就对自己的态度有如此大的转变。
是因为自己在这个世界的身份吗？
夜晚8点40分，庆尘在规定时间回到了自己的牢房。
当其他人都在列队回房的时候，他尝试着脱离队伍自由行动，果然，那些机器警卫已经不再管他。
只要他行走的方向是自己的牢房，机器警卫就不会把注意力放在他身上。
囚犯们纷纷用艳羡的眼神看着他，庆尘走在长长的回廊里，像是一头特立独行的狼。
单人间牢房里空荡荡的，待到合金闸门关闭后，他走去洗手台想要刷牙洗脸。

只是没走两步，庆尘忽然感觉到一阵强烈的困意来袭。
这困意来的极不正常，就算他白天里过度用脑，也不至于困到意志力都无法支撑的地步。
有怪异！
来不及多想，庆尘便躺倒在了地上。
梦里，庆尘清醒的站在一座昏暗的别墅客厅里。
起初他知道这是梦境，也很清楚自己的身体其实还在囚室里。
可两秒之后他便淡忘了一切，仿佛他本就应该在这里似的，也不再记得这是梦。
别墅客厅里有柴火在壁炉里燃烧，屋里有一种独特的潮湿味道，屋内的水份正在被壁炉烘烤蒸发，凝聚在房顶。
高高的房顶有一盏水晶吊顶，庆尘环视一周都没能找到它的开关。
这屋子里充满了诡异的感觉。
庆尘的瞳孔骤然收窄。
二楼楼梯正有血迹
客厅里摆放的沙发上有猫抓痕迹，皮革被锋利的爪子割开了一条又一条裂缝。
壁炉的台子上摆放着相框，相框的玻璃被人打碎了，照片不翼而飞。
墙壁上有青灰色的刀砍印子，壁炉火焰跳动时，那墙壁上的印子与沙发上的裂缝正在诡异扭曲。
地毯上，有一柄带血的匕首。
有人用血迹在地毯旁边的地板上写了两个醒目的大字：有鬼。
咚咚咚，门口传来敲门声。
【看书福利】关注公众号【书友大本营】每天看书抽现金/点币
庆尘深吸一口气，他没有碰屋内任何东西走向门边：“谁？”

外面传来轻松的声音：“警察，警号27149，是你报的警吗？请把门
庆尘皱眉，对方说话的声音明明很熟悉，但他却想不起来自己在什么地方听到过了。
奇怪，自己的记忆力出现问题了吗。
他迟疑着
那警察一开门便看到，正有血水从通往二楼的楼梯上流下来，他快步走上楼梯，边走边说：“报案人，请你站在原地别动，将门锁好！”
庆尘有些疑惑，这位警察的行事风格好像不符合流程，甚至没有配枪。
但不知道为什么，他潜意识便听从了对方的吩咐。
年轻警察上了楼，庆尘始终站在门口。
还没半分钟，门外竟再次传来敲门声。
庆尘问道：“谁？”
“警察，警号27149，是你报的警吗？请把门
庆尘愣了一下，警号27149不是已经上楼了吗，那门外是谁？
这一刻，潜意识里忽然有人用阴惨惨的声音问他：这时候，你会怎么办呢？你猜，门里门外到底哪个是真的？或者，都不是真的。
门外警察正在催促：“你好，请把门
庆尘再次深吸了一口气往屋里走去，他想要弯腰去捡取地摊上的带血匕首，可是他与匕首之间好像有一层透明的阻碍。
他与匕首只有一步之遥，却永远无法碰触。
有人不想让他拿刀。
有人想把他困在这里。
可他手臂上的回归倒计时还在跳动，他的心脏和血液也还在跳动、流淌。
他孤身一人无牵无挂的来到这个冰冷的机械世界，已经没有回头路可走了。

“滚开，”庆尘冷声说道，眼中的瞳孔再次收窄，仿佛用所有勇气化作一柄利刃，割开了某些东西。
别墅空荡的客厅里响起莫名的玻璃破碎声，他与匕首之间的阻碍破碎了。
有人轻轻的咦了一声。
庆尘拾刀，转身朝楼梯走去。
忽然间，不知道哪里的声音正在问他：拿刀干什么，你不给警察先生开门吗？
庆尘冷声回答：“等我杀了里面这个再开。”
林小笑：“？？？”
这时候庆尘终于记起来了，之前拿刀时破除阻碍的同时，也破除了这个梦魇对他记忆的屏蔽。
他认出这是林小笑的声音，那个年轻警察也是林小笑的模样。
他在林小笑为他制造的梦魇里。
这个世界，好像更有意思了。

content_en:
"I recognize the fish in the water, but is the shit in the stick real?" Lin Xiaoxiao stared at Ye Wan: "The boss can just kill me, what are you talking about?"
"Just telling the truth," Ye Wan replied calmly: "Let's get down to business, how do you plan to test that kid?"
Lin Xiaoxiao thought for a moment, then smiled meaningfully: "Let him have a nightmare first."
Ye Wan frowned: "That's enough."
"Don't worry."
At this time, there was a commotion behind the prisoners' meal queue, and Lin Xiaoxiao looked over.
Prison No. 18 is like a huge and empty iron box. When the meal is served, 21 robot guards are distributed around it, each with a loaded gun.
They have no human emotions and handle all emergencies in this prison.
The 21 robot guards are a bit less than the more than 3,000 prisoners, but every prisoner here knows that the drones and six-barreled metal storms embedded in the high dome above are the real threats.
Cold and powerful.
When meal time came at noon, all the prisoners lined up outside the restaurant on time and served their meals in order of floor.
Not only that, every prisoner must stand in his or her own place.
If a newcomer fails to remember his or her queue position, he or she will be immediately surrounded by machine guards to warn them. If they are still unable to return to their position after being warned, they will be punished with electric shocks by the machine guards and then escorted to their place.
The new prisoners had a welcome ceremony in the morning. How could they be so dizzy at this time?
As for the old prisoners, they were waiting for them to make a fool of themselves as if they were watching a joke. This seemed to be a fixed entertainment item every time a new prisoner was escorted in.
At this time, the old prisoners suddenly felt that something was wrong. Why was the young man who played chess with Uncle Li that morning not punished?
Everyone looked around the crowd and suddenly found Qingchen standing in his own place, watching everything calmly.
It's strange. There are at least five hundred people in each column. With so many strange faces standing together, how can this young man find his place?
Qingchen, on the other hand, was looking at the "new people" who were imprisoned with him.
I saw that none of the newcomers had any scars on their faces, but their walking postures were very strange, as if they were enduring pain.
It seemed that the prisoners were very measured in their attacks. If they didn't slap them in the face, they wouldn't be fatal.
He walked forward with the plate in his hand, but a hand suddenly pulled him out of the meal queue.
Qingchen was stunned. He turned to look at Lin Xiaoxiao, pulling him away and saying, "You don't have to queue up with them anymore. People who can play chess with the boss, what kind of queue should they queue up for?"
Qingchen subconsciously looked at the machine guards, fearing that he would be punished with an electric shock if he stepped out of the formation.
As a result, he found that the machine guard completely ignored him and urged other prisoners to fill his position!
Qingchen couldn't understand that even if Li Shutong and others were special, they wouldn't be so special, right? !
Lin Xiaoxiao pulled him through the long queues, picked up food, and sat across from Li Shutong to eat, all at once.
The prisoners on both sides watched this scene silently, and everyone's eyes were fixed on Qingchen.
The originally noisy environment suddenly became quiet, as if everyone had held their breath.
At this moment they realized that Qingchen was no longer the same as them.
Lin Xiaoxiao squatted on the chair next to Qingchen and said with a smile: "Don't be surprised. Those who can play chess with the boss will naturally have some special treatment. Eat it quickly, although the food in Prison No. 18 is not delicious at all."
Qingchen raised his head and looked at Li Shutong opposite him. He was eating slowly and had no intention of talking to him.
He looked at the crowd again, and Lu Guangyi in the queue was quietly giving him a thumbs up...
Qingchen didn't understand why Li Shutong was only willing to play chess with him in the morning.After one morning, my attitude towards myself changed so much.
Is it because of my identity in this world?
At 8:40 pm, Qingchen returned to his cell at the specified time.
When everyone else was lining up to go back to their rooms, he tried to break away from the team and move around freely. Sure enough, the machine guards no longer cared about him.
As long as he was walking in the direction of his cell, the robot guards would not pay attention to him.
The prisoners looked at him with envy. Qingchen walked in the long corridor like a maverick wolf.
The single cell was empty. After the alloy gate was closed, he walked to the sink to brush his teeth and wash his face.
Before he had even taken two steps, Qingchen suddenly felt a strong wave of sleepiness coming over him.
This sleepiness was extremely abnormal. Even if he used his brain excessively during the day, he would not be so sleepy that his willpower could not support him.
Something weird!
Without any time to think, Qingchen lay down on the ground.
In the dream, Qingchen stood awake in the living room of a dim villa.
At first he knew it was a dream and that his body was actually still in the cell.
But after two seconds, he forgot everything, as if he should be here, and no longer remembered that this was a dream.
There is firewood burning in the fireplace in the living room of the villa. There is a unique damp smell in the house. The moisture in the house is being evaporated by the fireplace and condensing on the roof.
There was a crystal ceiling on the high roof. Qingchen looked around but couldn't find the switch.
The room was filled with an eerie feeling.
Qingchen's pupils suddenly narrowed.
There are blood stains on the stairs on the second floor
There were cat scratch marks on the sofa placed in the living room, and the leather was cut one after another by sharp claws.
There was a photo frame on the fireplace table. The glass of the photo frame was broken and the photos were missing.
There were blue-gray knife marks on the wall, and when the fireplace flame danced, the marks on the wall and the cracks on the sofa were twisting strangely.
There was a bloody dagger on the carpet.
Someone wrote two eye-catching characters in blood on the floor next to the carpet: There is a ghost.
Dong dong dong, there was a knock on the door.

Qingchen took a deep breath and walked to the door without touching anything in the room: "Who?"
A relaxed voice came from outside: "Police, police number 27149, was it you who called the police? Please open the door.
Qingchen frowned. The other person's voice was obviously very familiar, but he couldn't remember where he had heard it before.
Strange, is there something wrong with my memory?
He hesitated
As soon as the policeman opened the door, he saw blood flowing down the stairs leading to the second floor. He walked up the stairs quickly and said as he walked: "Reporter, please stay where you are and lock the door! "
Qingchen was a little confused. The policeman's behavior seemed to be inconsistent with the procedures, and he didn't even have a gun.
But for some reason, he subconsciously obeyed the other party's instructions.
The young policeman went upstairs, while Qingchen stood at the door.
Not even half a minute later, there was another knock on the door.
Qingchen asked: "Who? "
"Police, police number 27149, was it you who called the police? Please hold the door
Qingchen was stunned for a moment. Wasn't the police number 27149 already upstairs? Who was outside the door?
At this moment, someone in his subconscious suddenly asked him in a gloomy voice: What will you do at this time? Guess which one is true inside and outside the door? Or, neither is true.
The police outside the door are urging: "Hello, please hold the door
Qingchen took a deep breath again and walked into the house. He wanted to bend down to pick up the bloody dagger on the floor, but there seemed to be a transparent barrier between him and the dagger.
He was only one step away from the dagger, but could never touch it.
Someone didn't want him to have a knife.
Someone wants to trap him here.But the return countdown on his arm was still beating, and his heart and blood were still beating and flowing.
He came to this cold mechanical world alone and without any worries, and there was no turning back.
"Go away," Qingchen said coldly, the pupils in his eyes narrowed again, as if all his courage turned into a sharp blade and cut something open.
There was an inexplicable sound of glass breaking in the empty living room of the villa, and the barrier between him and the dagger was shattered.
Someone let out a light sigh.
Qingchen picked up the knife, turned around and walked towards the stairs.
Suddenly, a voice from somewhere asked him: What are you doing with the knife? Why don't you open the door for Mr. Police?
Qingchen replied coldly: "Wait until I kill the one inside before opening the door."
Lin Xiaoxiao: "???"
At this time, Qingchen finally remembered that when he used the knife to break the obstacle, he also broke the nightmare's shield on his memory.
He recognized Lin Xiaoxiao's voice, and the young policeman also looked like Lin Xiaoxiao.
He was in the nightmare that Lin Xiaoxiao created for him.
This world seems to be more interesting.
